note: Literature and syndrome descriptions confirm behavioral abnormalities, autistic-like behavior, and hyperactivity are observed clinical features in YWHAZ-related Popov-Chang syndrome.

evidence.text: Descriptions of Popov-Chang syndrome note that affected individuals had significant behavioral abnormalities including autistic-like behavior, self-injury, and poor concentration.

source.title: Popov-Chang Syndrome
source.quote: Three had significant behavioral abnormalities, including autistic-like behavior, self-injurious behavior, fear of social interaction, and poor concentration.

evidence.text: Clinical and functional evaluations of YWHAZ variation associated with intellectual disability and developmental delay noted cognitive defects and hyperactivity consistent with clinical features.
